landing.hero.title: The right person is already in your network.
landing.hero.subtitle: Tell Ment what you're working through. See students and alumni with relevant experience, understand why they match, and ask for a short conversation.

landing.preview.privacy: Profiles are visible only to members of your university network.
landing.products.title: Real answers from real people
landing.products.subtitle: Students and alumni help each other make better choices, faster.
landing.products.universityDescription: Connect students and alumni across programs and cohorts. Match on shared strengths, career paths, and fresh perspectives so every student can reach real experience, right when they need it.
landing.how.title: From a question to a conversation
landing.how.step1Description: A private equity interview, moving to a new city, choosing a course — write it as you would say it.
landing.how.step2Description: Compare relevant experience, shared background, location, language, and availability.
landing.how.step3Description: Choose someone, edit the note, and find a time that works for both of you.
landing.trust.title: Built for trust
landing.trust.subtitle: Student and alumni data deserves serious privacy by default.
landing.trust.point1: Data hosted on EU servers (Supabase, eu-central-1).
landing.trust.point2: Aligned with GDPR and the revised Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection.
landing.trust.point3: Reflections and ratings stay private to the person who wrote them.
landing.trust.point4: AI features are opt-in and clearly disclosed, never on by default.
landing.finalCta.title: Someone in your network has probably done this before.
landing.finalCta.subtitle: Sign in and tell Ment who you'd like to speak with.
